claims.statement: For each selected original leaf, the tagged marked k-to-(k+1) incidence graph has left degrees equal to actual addability and right degrees k or k+1 according as the upper set has one or at least two marks, so E_v=kU_v+C_v. Alternating reachability from unmatched left vertices under a maximum matching gives N(X)=Y and |X|-|N(X)|=|S|. The count and cut identity are valid, but do not establish the primary weighted budget.

Neither that bound nor a map from first descent or selector values to those weighted cuts appears in the route evidence. Thus the gap and open status are properly stated.
